tips.label: 先看誰做動作
tips.text: 主詞做動作用主動；主詞承受動作用被動。被動的核心是 be + 過去分詞。

tips.label: 簡單式
tips.text: 現在：am/is/are + 過去分詞；過去：was/were + 過去分詞。be 要配合主詞單複數。

tips.label: 情態與未來
tips.text: can/must/should/will + be + 過去分詞；be going to be + 過去分詞。

tips.label: 完成與進行
tips.text: have/has been + 過去分詞表示已經或持續至今；be being + 過去分詞表示正在被做。

tips.label: 問句與否定
tips.text: 把第一個 be 或助動詞移到主詞前形成 Yes/No 問句；否定在第一個 be 或助動詞後加 not。

tips.label: 特殊結構
tips.text: be made to V；be seen/heard to V 或 V-ing；to be + 過去分詞；being + 過去分詞。

notes.title: 主動與被動：先找出動作的承受者
notes.rule:
主動：動作者 + 動詞 + 受詞
被動：原受詞 + be + 過去分詞（+ by + 動作者）
notes.description: 把原句受詞移到主詞位置，再依時態與新主詞決定 be。by 後用受格代名詞，如 me、him、her、us、them。動作者不明、不重要或泛指一般人時，常省略 by 片語。
examples: A volunteer saved the puppy. → The puppy was saved by a volunteer.（一位志工救了幼犬。）
We cleaned the yard. → The yard was cleaned by us.（庭院是我們打掃的。）
English is spoken here.（這裡有人說英語。）

notes.title: 簡單式被動與過去分詞
notes.rule:
現在：am/is/are + 過去分詞
過去：was/were + 過去分詞
notes.description: 現在的習慣可搭配 every day 等時間詞；過去事件常搭配 yesterday、last night 等。be 要配合單複數。過去分詞不一定等於過去式：write–wrote–written、see–saw–seen、choose–chose–chosen、give–gave–given、blow–blew–blown；hit–hit–hit、put–put–put 則不變。
examples: The baskets are washed every day.（這些籃子每天都會清洗。）
The old bridge was built in 1990.（這座舊橋建於 1990 年。）
The photos were pasted on the wall yesterday.（昨天有人把照片貼在牆上。）

notes.title: 簡單式被動的否定、問句與答句
notes.rule:
否定：主詞 + be not + 過去分詞
問句：Be + 主詞 + 過去分詞…？
notes.description: 被動句已有 be，不再加 do/does/did。簡答使用與問句相符的 be，詳答則保留過去分詞與其他必要資訊。疑問詞 When、Where 等放在 be 問句前。
examples: The fan was not turned on.（風扇沒有被打開。）
Were the seeds planted yesterday? Yes, they were.（種子昨天種下了嗎？是的。）
Is the yard cleaned every week? Yes, it is cleaned every week.（庭院每週都打掃嗎？是的，每週都打掃。）
When was this bridge built?（這座橋是什麼時候建造的？）

notes.title: 情態助動詞的被動
notes.rule: 主詞 + can/could/must/should/will… + be + 過去分詞
notes.description: 情態助動詞後的 be 維持原形，不因單複數改成 is 或 are。否定把 not 加在助動詞後；問句將助動詞前置。must not 表示禁止，cannot 表示不能。
examples: The tools must be kept dry.（工具必須保持乾燥。）
The broken swing must not be used.（不可以使用壞掉的鞦韆。）
Can this pipe be fixed? Yes, it can.（這根水管能修好嗎？可以。）

notes.title: 兩種未來式被動
notes.rule:
will be + 過去分詞
am/is/are going to be + 過去分詞
notes.description: 主詞承受將來的動作。will 後直接接 be；going to 前的 be 配合主詞，後面的 be 仍是原形。不要漏掉第二個 be。
examples: The bench will be moved tomorrow.（長椅明天會被搬走。）
These slides are going to be checked next week.（這些滑梯下週將接受檢查。）
Will the basket be sent today? No, it will not.（籃子今天會寄出嗎？不會。）

notes.title: 現在完成式被動
notes.rule:
have/has + been + 過去分詞
否定：have/has not/never been + 過去分詞
notes.description: 表示動作已完成、發生過，或狀況持續至今。單數第三人稱用 has，其他常用 have。since 接起點，for 接一段時間；already、yet、ever、never、次數也常出現。been 是 be 的過去分詞，不能漏掉。
examples: The missing wallet has been found.（遺失的錢包已經找到了。）
These tools have never been used.（這些工具從未使用過。）
Has the pipe been fixed yet? No, it has not.（水管修好了嗎？還沒有。）
The bridge has been closed for two days.（這座橋已經封閉兩天了。）

notes.title: 進行式被動：being 與 been 不同
notes.rule:
現在：am/is/are being + 過去分詞
過去：was/were being + 過去分詞
notes.description: 描述某個時間點正在被進行的動作。現在常見 now、at the moment；過去可配合另一件過去發生的事。being 用在進行式，been 用在完成式。判斷時也要看整個情境，不能只靠單一時間詞。
examples: The yard is being cleaned now.（庭院現在正在打掃。）
The swings were being painted when we arrived.（我們到達時，鞦韆正在上漆。）
The bench has been painted.（長椅已經漆好了。）

notes.title: 被動不定詞與被動動名詞
notes.rule:
不定詞被動：to be + 過去分詞
動名詞被動：being + 過去分詞
notes.description: want、hope、need 等結構可接被動不定詞；enjoy 後與介系詞 without 後用動名詞。主詞是動作的承受者時，選被動形式。need doing 也可表達需要被處理，本課先練習 need to be done。
examples: The basket needs to be washed.（籃子需要清洗。）
She hopes to be chosen for the team.（她希望被選入隊伍。）
He enjoys being invited to parties.（他喜歡受邀參加派對。）
She left without being noticed.（她離開時沒被人注意到。）

notes.title: 感官動詞與被動
notes.rule:
主動：see/hear + 人 + 原形動詞／V-ing
被動：人 + be seen/heard + to V／V-ing
notes.description: 主動感官句接原形動詞，改被動時要補 to；原句接 V-ing，改被動仍保留 V-ing。原形通常著重整個動作，V-ing 著重進行中的動作。兩者有時都能成立，因此做題時須依選項與語境判斷。
examples: We saw the boy run away. → The boy was seen to run away.（有人看到男孩跑走。）
We heard the girl singing. → The girl was heard singing.（有人聽到女孩正在唱歌。）
I saw the puppy fed by a volunteer.（我看到幼犬被志工餵食。）see + 受詞 + 過去分詞表示受詞承受動作。

notes.title: 使役 make 與 have 的相關結構
notes.rule:
主動：make + 人 + 原形動詞
被動：人 + be made + to V
have + 物 + 過去分詞
notes.description: make 表示叫某人做事；改被動時，後面的動詞要補 to。have + 物 + 過去分詞表示安排某物被處理，並不表示主詞親自完成動作。
examples: The teacher made us clean the yard.（老師叫我們打掃庭院。）
We were made to clean the yard.（我們被要求打掃庭院。）
Dad had the broken fan fixed.（爸爸請人修好了壞掉的風扇。）

notes.title: 授與動詞的兩種被動
notes.rule:
人 + be given + 物
物 + be given + to + 人
notes.description: give 後可以有兩個受詞，因此可以選人或物當被動句的主詞。以物為主詞時保留 to。不同動詞搭配的介系詞可能不同，不能把所有授與動詞一律套用 to。
examples: The coach gave the children new rackets.（教練給孩子們新的球拍。）
The children were given new rackets by the coach.（孩子們獲得教練送的新球拍。）
New rackets were given to the children by the coach.（新球拍被教練送給孩子們。）

notes.title: 口語 get 被動與片語保留
notes.rule:
get/got + 過去分詞
片語動詞改被動時，保留原本必要的介系詞或副詞
notes.description: 口語常用 get + 過去分詞表達遭遇或變化，例如 got hurt、got broken。take care of、laugh at 等片語改被動時，of、at 不能消失。這些用法作為補充說明，練習重點仍是被動動詞結構。
examples: The window got broken during the game.（比賽時窗戶被打破了。）
The puppy will be taken care of by my sister.（我的姊姊會照顧幼犬。）
The old bridge was blown up.（舊橋被炸毀了。）blow up 的過去分詞形式為 blown up。

quiz.question: Every morning, the floor of the senior center ___ before the doors open.
quiz.hint: Every morning 表示習慣；floor 是被打掃的單數主詞，用 is cleaned。

quiz.question: Many trees ___ near the bridge by our class last Saturday.
quiz.hint: last Saturday 是過去時間；trees 是複數且承受種植動作，因此用 were planted。

quiz.question: This wallet ___ of leather.
quiz.hint: wallet 是由皮革製成的物品，須有被動結構 is made；不能只放過去分詞 made。

quiz.question: A: Did the workers repair both swings yesterday? B: Yes. Both swings ___ before noon.
quiz.hint: 對話談 yesterday 的修理結果；both swings 為複數且被修理，用 were repaired。

quiz.question: The puppy ___ by a passing car last night, but it is safe now.
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去；puppy 是被車撞的，用 was hit。hit 的過去分詞仍是 hit。

quiz.question: A: ___ the cookies baked by your brother yesterday? B: Yes, they were.
quiz.hint: cookies 為複數，yesterday 表過去；被動問句把 were 放到主詞前，不加 did。

quiz.question: A: Is fresh bread baked here every morning? B: Yes, it ___.
quiz.hint: 問句以 Is 開頭，簡答沿用 be：Yes, it is.，不改用 does。

quiz.question: The seeds were ___ in the yard by the children.
quiz.hint: seeds 被孩子們種下；were 後接過去分詞 planted，形成被動。

quiz.question: The smoke ___ by everyone in the room a few minutes ago.
quiz.hint: a few minutes ago 指過去；smoke 是不可數名詞且被注意到，用 was noticed。

quiz.question: A: Was the missing wallet found? B: No, it ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Was，主詞 wallet 對應 it；否定簡答為 No, it wasn’t.。

quiz.question: The tools must ___ in a dry place after use.
quiz.hint: tools 是被保管的物品；must 後接 be + 過去分詞 kept。

quiz.question: These young puppies cannot ___ outside on a cold night.
quiz.hint: puppies 是被留在外面的對象；cannot + be + left，不能在 can 後加 to。

quiz.question: The broken pipe should ___ before we turn on the water.
quiz.hint: pipe 需要被修理；should 後用 be fixed，不是主動的 fix 或 be fixing。

quiz.question: A: Can this glue be used on wood? B: Yes, it ___.
quiz.hint: 問句的助動詞是 Can，肯定簡答也使用 can。

quiz.question: The baskets will ___ to the senior center tomorrow.
quiz.hint: tomorrow 表將來，baskets 承受寄送動作；will 後接 be sent。

quiz.question: A: Will the tennis court be cleaned today? B: No, it ___.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Will，否定簡答用 will not 的縮寫 won’t。

quiz.question: Please stay behind the fence. The old building is going to ___ next week.
quiz.hint: 建築物是被拆除的；is going to 後接 be + 過去分詞，形成未來被動。

quiz.question: The two benches ___ going to be moved into the yard.
quiz.hint: two benches 是複數主詞；going to 前的 be 用 are，後面的 be moved 保持不變。

quiz.question: A new swing is going to be ___ for the children.
quiz.hint: is going to be 後需要過去分詞；build 的過去分詞是 built。

quiz.question: All the bags ___ checked already, so we can leave now.
quiz.hint: already 與可以離開的結果表示檢查已完成；bags 為複數，用 have been checked。

quiz.question: The missing puppy ___ been found, and its owner is very happy.
quiz.hint: puppy 是單數第三人稱；現在完成式被動為 has been found。

quiz.question: This pot has never ___ used. It is still new.
quiz.hint: 現在完成式被動需要 has + been + 過去分詞；never 放在 has 與 been 之間。

quiz.question: A: Have the seeds been watered yet? B: No, they ___.
quiz.hint: 問句以 Have 開頭，seeds 為複數；否定簡答用 they haven’t。

quiz.question: ___ the fan been repaired yet? It still makes a loud noise.
quiz.hint: been repaired 與 yet 對應現在完成式被動；fan 是單數，因此用 Has 前置成問句。

quiz.question: The bridge has been ___ by many visitors this year.
quiz.hint: has been 後接過去分詞，表示橋已被許多遊客拍攝；因此用 photographed。

quiz.question: Listen! A new song is ___ sung in the next room.
quiz.hint: Listen 提示正在發生；is being sung 是現在進行式被動，been 用於完成式。

quiz.question: Workers are fixing the road right now. It ___ repaired at the moment.
quiz.hint: 前句明說工人正在修路；road 承受修理動作，用 is being repaired。

quiz.question: The wall was being ___ when we arrived at the senior center.
quiz.hint: was being 後仍須接過去分詞 painted，表示到達時牆正在上漆。

quiz.question: A: Is the bench being painted now? B: Yes, it ___.
quiz.hint: 現在進行式被動問句以 Is 開頭，肯定簡答保留 is。

quiz.question: When I came in, the seeds ___ being put into small bags.
quiz.hint: came in 表示過去的時點；seeds 為複數，過去進行式被動用 were being put。

quiz.question: The dirty basket needs ___ before we put fruit in it.
quiz.hint: basket 是需要被洗的物品；need to be + 過去分詞，選 to be washed。

quiz.question: The little boy hopes ___ for the school tennis team.
quiz.hint: 男孩希望被選進校隊；hope 後用 to V，此處用被動不定詞 to be chosen。

quiz.question: She doesn't enjoy ___ about her missing wallet again and again.
quiz.hint: enjoy 後接動名詞；她是被反覆詢問的人，因此用 being asked。

quiz.question: The man walked out without ___ by anyone.
quiz.hint: without 是介系詞，後接動名詞；男子沒被人注意，用 being noticed。

quiz.question: The glass needs to be ___ before we add hot water.
quiz.hint: to be 後接過去分詞 checked，表示玻璃杯需要被檢查。

quiz.question: The boy was seen ___ across the bridge with his dog.
quiz.hint: 感官動詞改被動可保留 V-ing；選項中只有 running 符合。若使用 run，前面必須有 to。

quiz.question: The puppy was heard ___ in the yard last night.
quiz.hint: 感官動詞主動句接原形動詞，改成 was heard 的被動時需補 to，因此選 to bark。

quiz.question: I saw the hungry puppy ___ a bowl of milk by a volunteer.
quiz.hint: 幼犬是被給牛奶的對象，志工是動作者；see + 受詞 + 過去分詞，選 given。

quiz.question: During the game, the students were made ___ behind the line.
quiz.hint: make 的被動結構是 be made to V；were made 後要用 to stand。

quiz.question: Before our trip, Dad had the car ___ by a mechanic.
quiz.hint: car 是被技師檢查的物品；have + 物 + 過去分詞，用 checked。

quiz.question: Mother made us ___ the empty pots inside before the storm.
quiz.hint: 這是主動使役句 make + 人 + 原形動詞，所以用 carry；只有 be made 的被動才補 to。

quiz.question: The window got ___ when a ball hit it.
quiz.hint: got + 過去分詞可以表示口語被動；break 的過去分詞是 broken，broke 是過去式。

quiz.question: A free lunch ___ to each person at the senior center yesterday.
quiz.hint: lunch 是被提供的單數主詞，yesterday 表過去；用 was given，後面保留 to each person。

quiz.question: Several children ___ new tennis rackets by the coach last week.
quiz.hint: children 是複數且接受球拍；last week 表過去，因此用 were given。

quiz.question: The children gave some seeds to the old man. Some seeds ___ to him.
quiz.hint: 前句說孩子把種子給老人；後句以複數 seeds 為主詞，轉成 were given。

quiz.question: As part of their weekly routine, volunteers ___ meals at the senior center every Sunday.
quiz.hint: volunteers 是煮飯的動作者，且為複數；習慣性的主動現在式用 cook，不用被動 are cooked。

quiz.question: Meals ___ by the volunteers every Sunday.
quiz.hint: meals 是被煮的複數主詞；every Sunday 表習慣，用 are cooked。

quiz.question: A: What happened to your toe? B: It ___ by a heavy pot that fell from the table this morning.
quiz.hint: it 指腳趾，是被掉落的鍋子弄傷的；描述過去事故，用 was hurt。

quiz.question: The heavy rain ___ the old bridge last night.
quiz.hint: rain 是造成損害的動作者，bridge 是受詞；last night 用主動過去式 damaged。

quiz.question: The note was ___ on the back of an old card.
quiz.hint: note 是被寫下的；was 後需要 write 的過去分詞 written，不是過去式 wrote。

vocab.sentence: The senior center is cleaned every day.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這間樂齡中心每天都有人打掃。

vocab.sentence: It is a pleasure to be invited.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 受邀讓人感到榮幸。

vocab.sentence: The man was attacked by a dog.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那名男子被一隻狗攻擊。

vocab.sentence: His toe was hurt in the game.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 他的腳趾在比賽中受傷了。

vocab.sentence: The bridge was built ten years ago.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這座橋建於十年前。

vocab.sentence: The glass was dropped on the floor.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那個玻璃杯被弄掉到地板上。

vocab.sentence: Smoke was seen near the bridge.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 有人看見橋附近有煙霧。

vocab.sentence: The puppy was saved by a boy.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那隻幼犬被一個男孩救了。

vocab.sentence: A table was put in the middle of the room.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 有人把一張桌子放在房間中央。

vocab.sentence: These bags must be carried carefully.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這些袋子必須小心搬運。

vocab.sentence: A note was left on my desk.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 有人在我的桌上留了一張紙條。

vocab.sentence: My wallet was found under the bench.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我的錢包在長椅底下被找到了。

vocab.sentence: The key was put in his pocket.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那把鑰匙被放進他的口袋裡。

vocab.sentence: We prayed that the puppy would be saved.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們祈禱那隻幼犬會獲救。

vocab.sentence: The old bridge was blown up.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那座舊橋被炸毀了。

vocab.sentence: The puppy was seen lying on the grass.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 有人看見那隻幼犬躺在草地上。

vocab.sentence: The boy was saved in time.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那個男孩及時獲救了。

vocab.sentence: This area must be kept clean.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個區域必須保持乾淨。

vocab.sentence: The glue was used to fix the toy.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 有人用這些膠水修理玩具。

vocab.sentence: The photos were pasted on the wall.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那些照片被貼在牆上。

vocab.sentence: The yard has already been cleaned.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 庭院已經打掃好了。

vocab.sentence: The broken pipe will be fixed tomorrow.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那根壞掉的水管明天會有人修理。

vocab.sentence: The bench is being painted now.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這張長椅現在正在上漆。

vocab.sentence: Badminton is played in our school every Friday.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們學校每星期五都有人打羽毛球。

vocab.sentence: Tennis can be played here after school.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 放學後可以在這裡打網球。

vocab.sentence: The slide must be checked before use.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這座滑梯使用前必須檢查。

vocab.sentence: The seesaw was fixed yesterday.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這座翹翹板昨天修好了。

vocab.sentence: The swing has been used by many children.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這座鞦韆已經有很多小朋友使用過。

vocab.sentence: These tools should be kept in the box.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這些工具應該放在箱子裡。

vocab.sentence: The pot was washed after dinner.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 晚餐後，鍋子被洗乾淨了。

vocab.sentence: The seeds were planted in the yard.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這些種子被種在庭院裡。

vocab.sentence: The basket is filled with fruit.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 籃子裡裝滿了水果。

vocab.sentence: The cookies were baked by my sister.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這些餅乾是我姊姊烤的。

vocab.sentence: A pack of cards was found in the box.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 有人在箱子裡找到一副紙牌。

vocab.sentence: The fan has not been turned on yet.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這台風扇還沒開。

vocab.sentence: A notice was put on the door.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 門上貼了一張告示。

vocab.sentence: Gas is used for cooking in this house.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個家用瓦斯煮飯。

vocab.sentence: A modern school will be built here.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這裡將興建一所現代化的學校。

vocab.sentence: The program has been watched by many students.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 很多學生已經看過這個節目。

vocab.sentence: The other side of the wall was painted blue.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 牆的另一面被漆成藍色。

vocab.sentence: The wallet was left somewhere in the house.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 錢包被遺留在屋內某處。

vocab.sentence: The missing puppy has been found.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那隻失蹤的幼犬已經找到了。

vocab.sentence: The boy was cheered up by his friends.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那個男孩在朋友的鼓勵下振作起來。

phrases.sentence: The old bridge was blown up.
The boy was saved in time.
The boy was cheered up by his friends.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 那個男孩在朋友的鼓勵下振作起來。

grammar.sentence: The old bridge was repaired after the storm.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那座舊橋在暴風雨後修好了。

grammar.sentence: These seeds are planted in small pots every spring.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這些種子每年春天都種在小盆子裡。

grammar.sentence: Was your wallet found near the senior center?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你的錢包是在樂齡中心附近找到的嗎？

grammar.sentence: The heavy bench must be carried by two people.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這張沉重的長椅必須由兩個人搬運。

grammar.sentence: Our missing puppy has finally been found.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們失蹤的幼犬終於找到了。

grammar.sentence: The broken pipe is being fixed right now.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 壞掉的水管現在正在修理。

grammar.sentence: A note was not left in my pocket.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我的口袋裡沒有被留下紙條。

grammar.sentence: Can these photos be pasted on the wall?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這些照片可以貼在牆上嗎？

grammar.sentence: The yard has not been cleaned yet.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 庭院還沒打掃。

grammar.sentence: We were made to move the heavy tools.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們被要求搬動那些沉重的工具。

grammar.sentence: The boy was seen to climb over the wall.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有人看見那個男孩爬過牆。

grammar.sentence: The windows need to be washed before the party.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 窗戶需要在派對前清洗。

grammar.sentence: The puppies are being fed by the children.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 孩子們正在餵幼犬。

grammar.sentence: The seeds will be put in this basket.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 種子將被放進這個籃子裡。

grammar.sentence: Has the new fan been tested yet?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 新風扇已經測試過了嗎？

grammar.sentence: The little girl was heard singing in the yard.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有人聽到小女孩在庭院裡唱歌。

grammar.sentence: Our dog was given some food by the boy.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那個男孩給了我們的狗一些食物。

grammar.sentence: She enjoys being invited to play badminton with friends.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她喜歡受邀和朋友一起打羽毛球。

grammar.sentence: This modern building was built by local workers.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這棟現代化建築是當地工人蓋的。

grammar.sentence: The slide is going to be painted tomorrow.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這座滑梯明天將會上漆。

grammar.sentence: These tools have never been used before.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這些工具以前從未被使用過。

grammar.sentence: I had my old tennis racket repaired yesterday.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我昨天請人修好了舊網球拍。

grammar.sentence: The puppy was not hurt in the attack.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那隻幼犬沒有在這次攻擊中受傷。

grammar.sentence: Are these cookies baked here every morning?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這些餅乾每天早上都在這裡烘烤嗎？

grammar.sentence: The old pot can be used to hold seeds.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這個舊盆子可以用來裝種子。

grammar.sentence: He left without being noticed by the teacher.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他離開時沒有被老師注意到。

grammar.sentence: A warm meal was given to each guest.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 每位客人都得到了一份熱騰騰的餐點。

grammar.sentence: The bridge was being checked when we arrived.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們到達時，那座橋正在接受檢查。

grammar.sentence: The missing wallet should be returned to its owner.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那個遺失的錢包應該歸還給失主。

grammar.sentence: Several windows got broken during the storm last night.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 昨晚暴風雨期間有幾扇窗戶被打破了。

cloze_quiz.question: This place offers meals and classes especially for older adults. It is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 提供長者餐點和課程的地方是 senior center（樂齡中心）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 這個地方特別為長者提供餐點與課程，是一間樂齡中心。

cloze_quiz.question: It is a great ___ to work with you. I really enjoy our time together.
cloze_quiz.hint: 後句說很享受相處時間，因此是 pleasure（愉快；榮幸），不是危險、問題或錯誤。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 能和你一起工作讓人很愉快。我很享受我們共處的時間。

cloze_quiz.question: The dog may ___ if someone tries to hurt its puppies.
cloze_quiz.hint: 有人想傷害幼犬時，母狗可能會 attack（攻擊）來保護牠們。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 如果有人試圖傷害牠的幼犬，這隻狗可能會攻擊。

cloze_quiz.question: A shoe that is too tight can hurt the big ___ on your foot.
cloze_quiz.hint: foot 上、會被鞋子壓到的是 toe（腳趾）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 太緊的鞋子可能會傷到你腳上的大拇趾。

cloze_quiz.question: The river is too deep to walk across, so we use the ___ to reach the other side.
cloze_quiz.hint: 用來跨越河流、抵達對岸的是 bridge（橋）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 河水太深，無法徒步涉過，所以我們利用橋到對岸。

cloze_quiz.question: Please don't ___ the bowl. It may break when it hits the floor.
cloze_quiz.hint: 後句提到碗落地可能破掉，因此前句要提醒不要 drop（使落下；丟下）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 請不要把碗弄掉，它撞到地板時可能會破。

cloze_quiz.question: Black ___ rose from the fire and made it hard to see.
cloze_quiz.hint: 從火中升起、遮住視線的是 smoke（煙霧）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 黑煙從火中升起，讓人難以看清楚。

cloze_quiz.question: Our dog gave birth last month. This little ___ is only four weeks old.
cloze_quiz.hint: 前句說狗生了寶寶，狗的幼獸叫 puppy（幼犬），不是其他動物的寶寶。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我們的狗上個月生了寶寶，這隻幼犬只有四週大。

cloze_quiz.question: There are five chairs in a row. The third chair is in the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 五張椅子排成一列，第三張在 middle（中間）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 五張椅子排成一列，第三張在中間。

cloze_quiz.question: This box is too heavy for the child to ___. Can you lift it for him?
cloze_quiz.hint: heavy 與 lift 提示搬運重量的問題，因此用 carry（攜帶；搬運）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 這個箱子太重，小孩搬不動。你能幫他提起來嗎？

cloze_quiz.question: I wrote "Back at six" on a small piece of paper and left the ___ on the table.
cloze_quiz.hint: 寫著簡短訊息的小紙片是 note（紙條）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我在一張小紙片上寫「六點回來」，並把紙條放在桌上。

cloze_quiz.question: I keep my money and bank cards in a small leather ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 用來放錢與銀行卡的小皮件是 wallet（錢包）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我把錢和銀行卡放在一個小皮錢包裡。

cloze_quiz.question: He put the coin into the small ___ on the front of his shirt.
cloze_quiz.hint: 襯衫前面可以放硬幣的小袋子是 pocket（口袋）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 他把硬幣放進襯衫前面的小口袋。

cloze_quiz.question: When their child was sick, the parents went to church to ___ for her.
cloze_quiz.hint: 孩子生病時父母到教堂為她 pray（祈禱）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 孩子生病時，父母到教堂為她祈禱。

cloze_quiz.question: Stay away from that bomb. It could ___ at any moment.
cloze_quiz.hint: 炸彈可能隨時 blow up（爆炸），所以要遠離。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 遠離那顆炸彈，它隨時可能爆炸。

cloze_quiz.question: You look tired. You can ___ down on this bed for a while.
cloze_quiz.hint: 疲倦時可以在床上 lie down（躺下）休息；lie 在本課是躺、臥。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 你看起來很累，可以在這張床上躺一會兒。

cloze_quiz.question: We saved the puppy ___. A few more seconds in the water would have killed it.
cloze_quiz.hint: 再晚幾秒幼犬就可能死亡，可見救援是 in time（及時）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我們及時救了幼犬；牠再多待在水中幾秒鐘就可能死去。

cloze_quiz.question: Only workers may enter this ___. Everyone else must stay outside the fence.
cloze_quiz.hint: 有圍欄並限制進入的範圍是 area（區域）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 只有工人可以進入這個區域，其他人必須留在圍欄外。

cloze_quiz.question: The paper pieces won't stick together. Please bring some ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 要把紙片黏在一起，需要 glue（膠水）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 這些紙片黏不起來，請拿一些膠水過來。

cloze_quiz.question: Let's ___ these paper stars onto the card with glue.
cloze_quiz.hint: with glue 和 onto the card 表示把紙星星 paste（黏貼）在卡片上。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我們用膠水把這些紙星星貼到卡片上吧。

cloze_quiz.question: The children are playing in the fenced ___ behind our house.
cloze_quiz.hint: 房子後方有圍欄、可以玩耍的戶外空間是 yard（庭院）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 孩子們正在我們家後方有圍欄的庭院裡玩耍。

cloze_quiz.question: This ___ carries water from the street into our house.
cloze_quiz.hint: 把水從街道輸送進屋內的是 pipe（水管）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 這根水管把水從街道輸送進我們家。

cloze_quiz.question: The long ___ has a flat seat and a back, so three people can sit on it.
cloze_quiz.hint: 有椅面和椅背、能讓三個人一起坐的長椅是 bench。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 這張長椅有平坦的椅面和椅背，能讓三個人坐在上面。

cloze_quiz.question: They hit a shuttlecock over a net while playing ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: shuttlecock 指羽毛球；用球拍把它打過網是 badminton。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 他們打羽毛球時，把羽毛球擊過球網。

cloze_quiz.question: The players use rackets to hit a yellow ball over a net in ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 用球拍將黃色球擊過網的運動是 tennis（網球）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 網球選手用球拍把黃色的球打過球網。

cloze_quiz.question: The child climbed up the steps and slid down the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 先爬階梯、再往下滑的遊樂設施是 slide（滑梯）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 那個孩子爬上階梯，再沿著滑梯滑下來。

cloze_quiz.question: Two children sat at opposite ends of the ___. As one went up, the other went down.
cloze_quiz.hint: 兩端的孩子一上一下，是 seesaw（翹翹板）的玩法。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 兩個孩子坐在翹翹板的兩端，一個上升時，另一個就下降。

cloze_quiz.question: She sat on the seat hanging from two ropes and moved back and forth on the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 由繩索吊起座位、能前後擺動的設施是 swing（鞦韆）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 她坐在由兩條繩子吊起的座位上，盪著鞦韆前後擺動。

cloze_quiz.question: A hammer is a useful ___ for fixing a chair.
cloze_quiz.hint: 槌子是修理東西用的 tool（工具）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 槌子是修理椅子時很好用的工具。

cloze_quiz.question: Mom is cooking soup in a large ___ on the stove.
cloze_quiz.hint: 在爐子上煮湯用的容器是 pot（鍋）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 媽媽正在用爐子上的大鍋子煮湯。

cloze_quiz.question: Put this tiny ___ in the soil and water it. It may grow into a tree.
cloze_quiz.hint: 種進土裡、澆水後可能長成樹的是 seed（種子）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 把這顆小種子放進土裡並澆水，它可能長成一棵樹。

cloze_quiz.question: She put the picked apples in a ___ with a handle and carried them home.
cloze_quiz.hint: 有提把、能裝採下來的蘋果並帶回家的是 basket（籃子）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 她把摘下的蘋果放進有提把的籃子，再帶回家。

cloze_quiz.question: Mix the flour, eggs, and sugar, then ___ the cake in the oven.
cloze_quiz.hint: 把蛋糕放進烤箱烘烤用 bake（烘焙）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 混合麵粉、蛋和糖，再把蛋糕放進烤箱烘烤。

cloze_quiz.question: We need a ___ of cards to play this game.
cloze_quiz.hint: a pack of cards 是一副紙牌；pack 在本課作名詞，表示一副或一包。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 玩這個遊戲需要一副紙牌。

cloze_quiz.question: It is hot, so turn on the electric ___ to move the air around.
cloze_quiz.hint: 用來送風、讓空氣流動的是 fan（風扇）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 天氣很熱，打開電風扇讓空氣流動吧。

cloze_quiz.question: Did you ___ that the door was open? I thought it was closed.
cloze_quiz.hint: 注意到門開著用 notice；本題考它的動詞義「注意到」。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 你有注意到門開著嗎？我以為門關了。

cloze_quiz.question: This car runs on ___, so we must stop at a gas station before the tank is empty.
cloze_quiz.hint: 車子使用的燃料、能在加油站補充的是 gas（汽油）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 這輛車使用汽油，因此油箱空掉前我們得去加油站。

cloze_quiz.question: We replaced the old machines with ___ ones that use the latest technology.
cloze_quiz.hint: 使用最新科技的新機器是 modern（現代的），與 old machines 形成對比。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我們用採用最新科技的現代機器替換了舊機器。

cloze_quiz.question: My favorite TV ___ is on at eight, so I'll watch it after dinner.
cloze_quiz.hint: 固定時間在電視播出的內容是 program（節目）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我最喜歡的電視節目八點播出，所以我會在晚餐後看。

cloze_quiz.question: Write your name on one ___ of the paper and draw a picture on the other.
cloze_quiz.hint: 紙張的一面用 side；另一面是 the other side。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 在紙的一面寫名字，另一面畫圖。

cloze_quiz.question: I know my glasses are ___ in this room, but I don't know exactly where.
cloze_quiz.hint: 知道眼鏡在房內、但位置不明，用 somewhere（在某處）。nowhere 是無處，everywhere 是到處。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我知道眼鏡在房間的某個地方，但不知道確切位置。

cloze_quiz.question: Our puppy is ___. We've looked all over the house but can't find it.
cloze_quiz.hint: 到處找卻找不到幼犬，表示牠 missing（失蹤的；找不到的）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我們的幼犬不見了。我們找遍整間屋子，還是找不到牠。

cloze_quiz.question: We hope these funny pictures will ___ our sad friend.
cloze_quiz.hint: 有趣的圖片希望讓傷心的朋友振作，使用 cheer up（使⋯振作起來）。
cloze_quiz.sentence_chinese: 我們希望這些有趣的圖片能讓傷心的朋友振作。
